Coca Cola (KO) vs Intel (INTC): on the same formula, their operating margins are 32.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — KO: $47.9B · INTC: $52.9B
• Revenue growth — KO: +1.9% · INTC: −0.5%
• Operating margin — KO: 28.7% · INTC: −4.2%
• Net margin — KO: 27.3% · INTC: −0.5%
• Free cash flow margin — KO: 11.0% · INTC: −9.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — KO: 5.5% · INTC: −9.6%

Different fiscal years: KO Dec 31, 2025 · INTC Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
